title: The Octopus Has Three Hearts (And Blue Blood)
description: Octopuses are stranger than any alien in the movies. Here is why their bodies work so differently from ours.

scenes.text: An octopus has three hearts, and one of them stops every time it swims.
Two hearts pump blood through the gills. The third pushes it around the rest of the body.
Its blood is blue, because it uses copper instead of iron to carry oxygen.
Two thirds of its neurons live in its arms, so each arm can taste, touch and decide on its own.
And it can change colour in a fraction of a second, even though it is colour blind.
Which octopus fact surprised you most? Tell me in the comments.
